description: Operator 2 (walk): traverse edges from a set of nodes with a recursive CTE (cycle-safe, depth capped). Direction out = dependencies/definitions, in = dependents/references — e.g. walk type=references dir=in from a symbol lists the files that import it. Each node returns its traversal depth and a path:line citation.

edgeType.description: Edge types to follow. Defaults to all.

start.description: Node ids or keys, as returned by graph_find.

name: graph_walk
title: Walk the graph
